definition: Minor page faults of one fresh process, spawn to exit: the median of 50 runs of the static dist build on the CI's Linux runner (bench_cli.py). A command without a number is only reported. Set a number about 5% above what the command measures, because changes elsewhere move the binary's layout and with it a few faults. Raising a number needs a reason below.
reason: CI run 41986118445 (binary b182cf613216, EPYC 9V45) measured 241, 365, 364 and 302; these are 5% above. Runners agree: one binary took the same medians on EPYC 7763 and 9V45.
